Inspection 
and Repair Out Side the Drum

items:
Screw off the nuts (1) to (13) 0f the level 
 glasses.

Screw off the nuts (1-1) to (1-13) of the level 
 glasses.
Screw off the bolts (14-15)
Screw off the bolts (16-17)
Change the Mecca if needed

Screw off nuts for gland valves before and 
 after the level glasses.
Take up the gland follower
Talk up the baking of gland to change it

Check the pressure gauge and change it if 
 needed.

items: Screw off the nuts (1) of the manholes
Screw off the nuts (2) of the manholes
Open manholes.

Talk up the metalloplastic sealing of manholes 
 and change it.

Check the tubes for drain inside drum and change 
 if needed.

Check the vent of tubes and tubes from outside for chemical treatment 
 and change it if needed
Clean the cyclone properly.

text:
Introduction
These document lists the 
maintenance procedure P1, which must carried on an annually bases as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block of boiler drum which used for feeding walls with water and 
super heaters with saturated steam.
The first draft 
initiated and tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Bsiouny, accepted by general director 
pre. eng. 
Saad Mostafa, revised by eng.
Samir Abed El 
Gelil at EDEPC, and approved by eng. Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector 
of Talkha power station.
Technical Data
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Drum must be out of operation.
Pressure in the drum should be zero.
Drain the drum and vents open.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning fluid.
Suitable lifting device.
Work to be Carried Out
Before 
Isolated the Drum Mechanically
Check any leakage from the manholes.
Check any leakage from the level glass 
 valves.
Check any leakage. From the pressure gauge.
Check any leakage from the Mecca (plastic 
 strips)
Check the drum during operation.
Check any leakage from the safety valve of 
 drum
Check any leakage from the manholes.
Check any leakage from the level glass 
 valves.
Check any leakage. From the pressure gauge.
Check any leakage from the Mecca (plastic 
 strips)
Check the drum during operation.
Check any leakage from the safety valve of 
 drum
After Isolated the Drum Mechanically
Be sure the boiler out of operation and the 
 pressure inside the drum must be zero
Be sure the drum is drained..
Be sure the vents opened.
Be sure the temperature inside the drum (35 
 C )
Inspection 
and Repair Out Side the Drum
Screw off the nuts (1) to (13) 0f the level 
 glasses.
Screw off the nuts (1-1) to (1-13) of the level 
 glasses.
Screw off the bolts (14-15)
Screw off the bolts (16-17)
Change the Mecca if needed
Screw off nuts for gland valves before and 
 after the level glasses.
Take up the gland follower
Talk up the baking of gland to change it
Check the pressure gauge and change it if 
 needed.
Inspection and Repair Inside the Drum
Screw off the nuts (1) of the manholes
Screw off the nuts (2) of the manholes
Open manholes.
Talk up the metalloplastic sealing of manholes 
 and change it.
Check the tubes for drain inside drum and change 
 if needed.
Check the vent of tubes and tubes from outside for chemical treatment 
 and change it if needed
Clean the cyclone properly.
Note: If you 
need any help please go to the operating instruction for repairs and maintenance 
D-3.
